title: Grants for Brevard County
lead: Brevard County already moves large state and federal grants through its budget. Here is what fits the needs this site has documented — and what to know before counting on it.

fits.text: Florida DEP’s Indian River Lagoon water quality grants pay for stormwater, wastewater and septic-to-sewer work; this year’s round is closed. Federal BRIC money (up to 75%) pays for drainage that lowers flood damage; Florida’s notices of interest closed August 14. The county’s own lagoon sales tax is up for renewal on November 3 — facts only on this site.
Opioid settlement money can fund treatment tied to the jail. Federal Justice Department programs for treatment courts and re-entry are listed below with their deadlines.
Resilient Florida pays for projects that protect critical assets once a vulnerability assessment is done. The 2026 window closed September 1.

FRDAP park grants of up to $200,000 per request close October 15, 2026. FIND’s Waterways Assistance Program pays up to 50–75% of boat ramp, dredging and shoreline work; Brevard is one of its 12 counties, and applications are due by the end of March.

not_available: Florida’s Small County Outreach Program is for counties of about 200,000 people or fewer; Brevard has about 658,000.
Florida’s Rural Infrastructure Fund is for rural communities; Brevard isn’t rural.

already.text: The jail’s budget counts a $48,000 Eastern Florida State College reimbursement for a veterinary technician program.
The Housing and Human Services Department budgets $5,390,255 of grants and aid this year.

help.text: The East Central Florida Regional Planning Council serves Brevard and seven other counties.

help.text: The Florida Association of Counties helps counties with grants and policy.
